thread_text:
elaine: Heads-up — after the outage earlier tonight the docs page under /guides/retries has outdated status links and is missing the quick workaround. Need a small hotpatch: add statuspage permalink, a Known Issue banner, and a short retry example. Can someone take PR + rapid review? cc @nina :wave:

nina: On it. I'll branch from docs/main and open a PR. Planning to: 1) add a top banner (KNOWN ISSUE), 2) insert status page link, 3) add a tiny bash snippet for retry/backoff. If we need, we can backport to release-v1.2. Will request sam + anita for review.

matt: thanks. if this is docs-only i'm fine with fast-track merge once docs-ci preview is green. Prefer backport only if customers on v1.2 report issues.

sam: I can review quickly. Prefer the banner be one short sentence and link to postmortem later. Also check wording around 'exponential backoff' to avoid implying library-level behavior.

docs-ci: Preview available for PR #4567: https://preview.docs.redwood-inference.com/pr-4567 — note: failing image links in troubleshooting (404).

nina: Got it, fixing paths now. Pushed commit 3ab4f9e (updated image paths, added banner, added snippet). PR #4567 now has the snippet: ```bash
# quick retry example
for i in 1 2 3; do
  curl -sS -X POST \"https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate\" -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"prompt":"x","max_tokens":32}' && break || sleep $((2**i))
done
```

sam: LGTM aside from one tiny wording nit in the banner. Suggest: \"Known issue (23:09–23:18 UTC): intermittent 503s — retry with exponential backoff up to 3 attempts.\"

anita: Approving review. Please also add a link to the status page with the permalink to the incident, and note we'll add a postmortem link once published.

elaine: Status page permalink is: https://status.redwood.inference/incidents/2026-03-19/kennel-02 — please use that exact URL in the banner. Also include the short customer-facing workaround: retry up to 3 times with backoff; don't recommend client-side circuit breakers here.

nina: Added permalink and updated banner wording per sam and elaine. Banner text now: \"Known issue (2026-03-19 23:09–23:18 UTC): intermittent 503s; workaround — retry with exponential backoff (up to 3 attempts). See https://status.redwood.inference/incidents/2026-03-19/kennel-02 for updates.\" Pushed commit 7d1c2.

docs-ci: Preview OK: https://preview.docs.redwood-inference.com/pr-4567/2 (all checks green).

matt: good. plan: merge docs-only hotfix after docs-ci green and no outstanding comments. I'll schedule merge at 13:45 PST to avoid concurrent infra deploys.

deploy-bot: No infra or runtime change detected for this merge — docs-only.

sre-oncall: Confirmed the status page permalink above (matches incident record).

nina: Merging now per matt's window. Will open backport PR to release-v1.2 if customer reports come in; otherwise we'll just ship main. Thanks for the quick reviews :heart:
